description: The bar chart illustrates ROUGE evaluation scores at different training steps, showing three metrics (ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L) for each step value. The horizontal axis contains the categorical step values labeled 100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000 (in increasing order) with the axis label “Step,” while the vertical axis represents the ROUGE score values on a linear scale (no explicit y-axis label is visible), with bar-top numeric annotations providing exact values. For each step, three adjacent bars form a grouped set: ROUGE-1 is shown as a blue diagonally hatched bar, ROUGE-2 as a light teal diagonally hatched bar, and ROUGE-L as an orange diagonally hatched bar, with a legend in the upper-left identifying these colors/labels. At step 100, the bars are labeled 6.3 (ROUGE-1), 0.1 (ROUGE-2), and 3.0 (ROUGE-L); at 250 they are 11.6, 0.4, and 8.3; at 500 they are 21.1, 4.1, and 15.9; at 1000 they are 38.3, 16.5, and 30.7; and at 2000 they are 41.2, 19.1, and 33.4. The bars are not shown as stacked, and there is no additional visual emphasis such as outlines beyond the consistent hatch styling and the numeric value annotations above each bar.
